payout_quote: Arizona Research Center official all-studies page (azresearchcenter.com): 'Cardiovascular Disease - This study is currently enrolling patients! Age: 18 & up, Male & Female, Compensation up to $1,900'. The cardiovascular study page adds: 'If you qualify and are enrolled in this study, it may last up to 4.5 years, and you may be compensated for your time and travel... All study-related care, tests, and medication are provided at no cost... no insurance is required.'
steps: Open Arizona Research Center's official all-studies page (azresearchcenter.com) and confirm the cardiovascular disease study is currently enrolling.
Review the criteria: 18+, history of heart problems/stroke or at risk, stable cholesterol-lowering medication, no history of drug or alcohol abuse; additional criteria apply.
Complete the interest form; staff will confirm pre-qualification (not everyone qualifies).
Pass medical screening and enroll; study-related care, tests, and medication are provided at no cost with no insurance required.
Complete study visits over up to 4.5 years; receive compensation up to $1,900 for time and travel.
catches: The study requires a history of heart problems/stroke or high risk plus other medical criteria; not everyone qualifies.
Compensation is an 'up to $1,900' ceiling tied to a long study (up to 4.5 years); per-visit pay is modest.
The study 'may last up to 4.5 years' with repeated on-site visits in Phoenix - the $1,900 ceiling is spread across a very long study course.
Participants may receive the study drug or a placebo; the investigational drug AZD0780 carries real medical risks.
The study is on-site in Phoenix, Arizona - you must attend clinic visits there.
Other studies on the page show 'Compensation TBD' or waiting lists; the concrete amount applies only to the cardiovascular study.
The official listing does not state the exact visit schedule or visit count, so the total time above is an estimate — the actual time commitment could be higher.
You must pass the study screening process (medical history review, labs/exams as required) to enroll; not everyone qualifies.
biggest_catch: You must medically qualify for a cardiovascular study and attend on-site visits in Phoenix over up to 4.5 years; $1,900 is an 'up to' ceiling for the full course, and you may receive a placebo plus real investigational-drug risks.
eligibility: 18+; history of heart problems, stroke, or high risk; stable cholesterol-lowering medication; no history of drug or alcohol abuse; additional criteria apply.
timing: Compensation for time and travel over up to 4.5 years; study-related care, tests, and medication at no cost; no insurance required.
